div.div: v31: Added Eagle Blocks puzzle game, moved "Go to Latest Version" button to menu, bug fixes and layout optimization.
v30: Added custom video background uploader with local storage persistence, intro welcome overlay animation, and update log history.
v28-v29: Integrated notification bell dropdown for JSONBin live announcements, Kansas central time clock, and Eagle Stack Tower game.
v26-v27: Added favorites filtering system, escape key toggle setting, custom RGB/hex background color picker, and smooth scroll-to-top feature.
v1-v25: Initial arcade hub creation, single-file SVG foreignObject architecture, individual game integrations (Pong, Geometry Eagle, Pizza, Clicker, etc.).
